'''Skagway''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Prisoner/Legends|inmate]] of the [[Cog Hive Seven]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. He [[Death/Legends|died]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]] at the hands of the [[Bone Kings]], one of the prison's two largest gangs, who slaughtered the Rodian and ripped out his [[Bone/Legends|bones]] for use as makeshift weapons.
